requirements_summary.purpose: Site feasibility assessment and regulatory compliance for datacentre development project

data_sources_currently_available.name: Satellite Vegetation Index Data
data_sources_currently_available.justification: Can provide baseline land use and vegetation assessment for the Gachibowli area to understand habitat impacts. Global coverage includes India.
data_sources_currently_available.applicability: Partial - useful for land use baseline but not specific to datacentre impacts

data_sources_currently_available.name: Digital Elevation Models
data_sources_currently_available.justification: Provides topography data for site characterization, drainage analysis, and understanding heat dispersion patterns. Global coverage includes India.
data_sources_currently_available.applicability: Full - terrain data is universally applicable

data_sources_needed.name: India Meteorological Department (IMD) Climate Data
data_sources_needed.justification: Required for baseline temperature, humidity, wind patterns, and precipitation data for Hyderabad region. Essential for assessing cooling requirements and heat island impacts.

data_sources_needed.name: Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) Air Quality Data
data_sources_needed.justification: Baseline air quality for Hyderabad/Gachibowli area. Needed to assess incremental impacts from datacentre diesel generators and evaluate compliance with Indian air quality standards.
data_sources_needed.suggested_source: CPCB real-time monitoring network, State PCB Telangana

data_sources_needed.name: Hyderabad Water Resources and Quality Data
data_sources_needed.justification: Critical for assessing water availability for datacentre cooling systems and baseline water quality. Datacentres require significant water for cooling towers.
data_sources_needed.suggested_source: Central Ground Water Board (CGWB), Telangana State Water Resources Department

data_sources_needed.name: Gachibowli Area Land Use and Urban Planning Data
data_sources_needed.justification: Current land use classification, urban zoning, protected areas, and sensitive receptors (schools, hospitals, residential areas) near the proposed site.
data_sources_needed.suggested_source: Hyderabad Metropolitan Development Authority (HMDA), Survey of India

data_sources_needed.name: Telangana Biodiversity and Habitat Data
data_sources_needed.justification: Identify any endangered species, critical habitats, or ecologically sensitive zones in the Gachibowli area that could be impacted by land use change.
data_sources_needed.suggested_source: Telangana State Biodiversity Board, Wildlife Institute of India

data_sources_needed.name: Telangana Power Grid and Energy Mix Data
data_sources_needed.justification: Required for carbon footprint calculations - need to know the carbon intensity of grid electricity in Telangana (coal vs. renewable energy mix).
data_sources_needed.suggested_source: Telangana State Electricity Board (TSSPDCL), Central Electricity Authority

data_sources_needed.name: Ambient Noise Level Data for Gachibowli
data_sources_needed.justification: Baseline ambient noise levels to compare against datacentre-generated noise from cooling systems, generators, and HVAC equipment.
data_sources_needed.suggested_source: Telangana State PCB noise monitoring, urban noise surveys

analysis_models_currently_available.note: No models in current catalog are applicable to datacentre environmental impact assessment. All 9 existing models focus on wildfire risk assessment in the United States.

analysis_models_needed.name: Datacentre Energy Consumption and Carbon Footprint Model
analysis_models_needed.justification: Core model for calculating energy usage based on IT load, cooling requirements, and PUE (Power Usage Effectiveness). Must calculate Scope 1, 2, and 3 emissions based on India grid factors.

analysis_models_needed.name: Datacentre Water Consumption and Thermal Impact Model
analysis_models_needed.justification: Calculates water requirements for cooling systems (evaporative cooling towers vs. air-cooled chillers) and assesses thermal pollution from wastewater discharge.
addresses_impacts: heat emissions and local temperature impacts
required_inputs: cooling system design (water vs. air cooled)

analysis_models_needed.name: Urban Heat Island and Microclimate Impact Model
analysis_models_needed.justification: Assesses heat rejected from datacentre cooling systems and its impact on local ambient temperatures. Critical for urban areas like Gachibowli.
addresses_impacts: heat emissions and local temperature impacts
required_inputs: Heat rejection rate from cooling systems

analysis_models_needed.name: Datacentre Air Quality Impact Model
analysis_models_needed.justification: Assesses air emissions from diesel backup generators, emergency testing, and any on-site combustion equipment. Compares to Indian NAAQS (National Ambient Air Quality Standards).
outputs: Pollutant concentration predictions (PM, NOx, SO2, CO)

analysis_models_needed.name: Datacentre Noise Impact Assessment Model
analysis_models_needed.justification: Evaluates noise from cooling towers, chillers, generators, HVAC systems, and transformers. Assesses compliance with Indian noise standards (Industrial/Commercial/Residential zone limits).
required_inputs: Equipment specifications and sound power levels
Indian noise standards for zone classification
outputs: Noise contour maps (dB levels at various distances)

analysis_models_needed.name: Land Use Change and Habitat Impact Model
analysis_models_needed.justification: Assesses direct habitat loss from site development, fragmentation effects, and impacts on local biodiversity. Identifies any protected species or critical habitats.

analysis_models_needed.name: Integrated Datacentre Environmental Impact Assessment
analysis_models_needed.justification: Comprehensive model combining all impact categories to produce integrated assessment aligned with Indian EIA notification requirements (2006, as amended).
required_inputs: Outputs from all individual impact models

analysis_plan.primary_goal: Conduct comprehensive ecological impact assessment for proposed datacentre in Gachibowli, Hyderabad to support site feasibility evaluation and regulatory compliance with Indian environmental laws (Environment Protection Act, Water Act, Air Act, EIA Notification 2006).
workflow_steps: Phase 1: Data Collection - Gather baseline environmental data for Gachibowli area (climate, air quality, water resources, land use, biodiversity, noise levels)
Phase 2: Baseline Characterization - Establish pre-project environmental conditions using satellite imagery, terrain data, and local monitoring data
Phase 3: Impact Prediction - Energy/Carbon - Calculate energy consumption and carbon footprint based on datacentre design specifications
Phase 4: Impact Prediction - Water Resources - Assess water demand, availability, and thermal pollution potential
Phase 5: Impact Prediction - Heat Island - Model microclimate impacts from heat rejection
Phase 6: Impact Prediction - Air Quality - Dispersion modeling for generator emissions and compliance assessment
Phase 7: Impact Prediction - Noise - Acoustic modeling and compliance with Indian noise standards
Phase 8: Impact Prediction - Land Use/Habitat - Biodiversity impact assessment and habitat evaluation
Phase 9: Integrated Assessment - Combine all impact predictions into comprehensive EIA
Phase 10: Mitigation Design - Develop Environmental Management Plan with mitigation measures
Phase 11: Regulatory Mapping - Map findings to Indian environmental clearance requirements
Phase 12: Deliverables - Prepare final reports, GIS maps, and compliance documentation
analysis_plan.estimated_timeline: 45-60 days (given data collection requirements and model development needs)
analysis_plan.computational_requirements: Medium (individual models are low-medium complexity, but comprehensive data processing required)
deliverables: Energy consumption and carbon footprint analysis
Air quality impact assessment with dispersion modeling
Noise impact assessment with contour maps
Regulatory compliance matrix (aligned with Indian EIA requirements)
Sustainability scorecard and green datacentre recommendations
